summary: Spend time with your grandfather & grandmother in great-grandparents family home
description:
Experience the joy of visiting your grandparents' house and living the sweetest moments with them in this ultimate family role-playing game. Step into a grandma house cozy home filled with love, toys, and fun activities, perfect for babies, grandkids, and even great-grandparents! Whether you're taking care of babies in the grandma house, daycare, exploring new places with your grandparents, or simply enjoying a peaceful day at home, this game lets you dive into the heartwarming world of family life.

Welcome to Grandma house
In My Tizi Town Grandparents Home, you’ll enter the dream house where grandma and grandpa live. It’s a magical place where every room is filled with memories and love. From the cozy kitchen where grandma bakes cookies to the playroom filled with toys for babies, this home is perfect for every member of the family. It's not just a house—it’s a home sweet home where life is always sweet!

The adventure starts the moment you step into the living room, the heart of your grandma house. Surrounded by cozy furnishings and cherished family memories. The real magic happens when your grandfather and grandmother share tales of their past adventures and travels, sparking your imagination and filling you with joy.

The adventure doesn’t stop with grandparents! There’s a daycare in the house where you can take care of babies and toddlers. Play with them, feed them, and make sure they’re always happy. The daycare is packed with toys and fun activities, ensuring that every baby has the best time.

Explore the World with Grandfather and Grandmother!  
Every day is an adventure with your grandparents! Travel to new locations with them and explore places outside of their home. Pack your bags and set out on fun family trips where you can discover hidden treasures and create unforgettable memories with your grandparents. Traveling with grandpa and grandma is always filled with fun surprises! At grandma's house, the whole family gets together to enjoy quality time and have some family fun.

Play at your Grandma House
Step into the playhouse in your grandparents’ backyard, where endless adventures await. This isn’t just any playhouse; it's where the grandkids can let their imagination run wild! Pretend to be a superhero, host a tea party, or even create your own games—there’s no limit to the fun you can have. It’s the perfect place for grandkids to play and bond with their grandparents.

A Happy Family Game
My Tizi Town Grandparents Home is all about bringing the family together. Whether you’re spending time with grandma, grandpa, or even your great-grandparents, this game is designed to make everyone feel like part of a happy family. Create your own avatars, customize them, and role-play different family scenarios. You can even create your own stories—life is as sweet as you make it! Grandfather and grandmother always make sure the whole family enjoys every moment together, whether playing in the garden or relaxing at home.

Experience the Sweet Life
In this game, the sweet life is all about family. Whether you're helping grandma in the garden, spending time with grandpa in his workshop, or simply relaxing at home with the entire family, My Tizi Town Grandparents Home offers endless possibilities for fun. Grandma's house is the heart of the family, where everyone comes together to celebrate love and laughter. The love between grandparents and grandkids is something truly special, and this game celebrates every moment of that bond. In My Tizi Town Grandparents Home, you'll experience heartwarming family fun like other popular apps Toca Boca, Avatar World, and Pazu, offering a unique blend of creative role-play and immersive family adventures!

Join the fun in My Tizi Town Grandparents Home, where every day is filled with love, laughter, and adventure!
